chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
How easy it is to make the people happy with you: restrain your tongues from them.
ai.seo_question: How can one easily gain the favor of people according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the virtue of *kaff al-lisan* (restraining the tongue) as the primary means to secure the goodwill of the general public (*al-nas*). This teaching aligns with the Shia concept of *al-mu'asarah bi-l-husn* (social conduct with excellence), emphasizing that avoiding gossip and backbiting is a practical path to maintaining social harmony and preventing unnecessary enmity.

en.hubeali: H 14984 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘How easy it is to make the people to be happy with you. Just restrain your tongues from (speaking against) them’.
en.sarwar: 538. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa and Abu Ali Al-Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, together from Ali Bin hadeed, from Jameel Bin Darraaj, from Zurara who said:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) was in the Sacred Masjid. So there was a mention of the Clan of Umayya and their government. Some of his (a.s.) companions said to him (a.s.), ‘We hope that you (a.s.) will become their master and that Allah (azwj) will Display this Command upon your (a.s.) hands’. So he (a.s.) said: ‘I (a.s.) am not their master, nor am I (a.s.) happy to be their master, for their companions are the sons of adultery. Allah (azwj) never Created, since the creation of the Heavens and the earth, years nor days shorter than their years and their days. Allah (azwj) Ordered the Angels in who hands is the orbit, to rotate it like a scroll’.
